subject: How-to on using lavaan with the European Social Survey

messages.subject: How-to on using lavaan with the European Social Survey
parts:
Dear lavaan users,


For those of you who might be interested in using lavaan to estimate SEM's on European Social Survey (ESS) data: there is now an R-bloggers post by Anthony D'Amico post explaining how you can do this while accounting for the ESS's complex sampling design (http://bit.ly/1lktsuD). 


Best regards,
Daniel
